summary_en: ~2.6B yen proceeds from sale of listed cross-holdings. Target: reduce cross-holdings to <10% of consolidated net assets by end-Mar 2030. Sale completion planned by end-Sep 2029. Proceeds to be deployed toward sustainable growth and capital efficiency. ~700M yen gain expected in FY3/27.
title_en: Notification regarding policy to reduce strategic shareholdings and expected extraordinary gain from sale of strategic shareholdings
translation_en_brief: On 5 June 2026, Futaba Corporation's board of directors approved a policy to reduce strategic shareholdings and the sale of certain cross-held securities. The company aims to reduce the ratio of strategic shareholdings to less than 10% of consolidated net assets by the end of March 2030, in order to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen financial position in line with the Corporate Governance Code. The sale targets a portion of listed securities, with completion expected by the end of September 2029, generating approximately 2.6 billion yen in proceeds (at current stock prices). Of this, approximately 700 million yen in gains is expected to be recorded in the FY3/27 results (ended 31 March 2027), which has been incorporated into the earnings forecast announced on 12 May 2026. The company intends to deploy the proceeds from the sale toward sustainable growth and capital-efficient investments. Management will conduct careful dialogue with affected trading partners regarding the reduction policy.
